macros.name: beamerbutton
macros.doc: Draws a button with the given ⟨button text⟩.

macros.name: beamergotobutton
macros.doc: Draws a button with the given ⟨button text⟩. Before the text, a small symbol (usually a right-pointing arrow) is inserted that indicates that pressing this button will jump to another “area” of the presentation.

macros.name: beamerreturnbutton
macros.doc: The symbol drawn for this button is usually a left-pointing arrow. Use this button if pressing it will return from a detour.

macros.name: beamerskipbutton
macros.doc: The symbol drawn for this button is usually a double right arrow. Use this button if pressing it will skip over a well-defined part of your talk.

macros.name: hyperlinkappendixend
macros.doc: Clicking the text jumps to the last slide of the appendix.

macros.name: hyperlinkappendixstart
macros.doc: Clicking the text jumps to the first slide of the appendix.

macros.name: hyperlinkdocumentend
macros.doc: Clicking the text jumps to the last slide of the presentation or, if an appendix is present, to the last slide of the appendix.

macros.name: hyperlinkdocumentstart
macros.doc: Clicking the text jumps to the first slide of the presentation.

macros.name: hyperlinkframeend
macros.doc: Clicking the text jumps to the last slide of the current frame.

macros.name: hyperlinkframeendprev
macros.doc: Clicking the text jumps to the last slide of the previous frame.

macros.name: hyperlinkframestart
macros.doc: Clicking the text jumps to the first slide of the current frame.

macros.name: hyperlinkframestartnext
macros.doc: Clicking the text jumps to the first slide of the next frame.

macros.name: hyperlinkpresentationend
macros.doc: Clicking the text jumps to the last slide of the presentation.

macros.name: hyperlinkpresentationstart
macros.doc: Clicking the text jumps to the first slide of the presentation.

macros.name: hyperlinkslidenext
macros.doc: Clicking the text jumps one slide forward.

macros.name: hyperlinkslideprev
macros.doc: Clicking the text jumps one slide back.

macros.name: insertbuttontext
macros.doc: \insertbuttontext inserts the text of the current button.

macros.name: insertdocumentendpage
macros.doc: \insertdocumentendpage Inserts the page number of the last page of the document (including the appendix). • \usebeamertemplate*{page number in head/foot} inserts a customisable template which e.g. inserts the current and total number of frames.

macros.name: insertnavigation
macros.doc: \insertnavigation{⟨width⟩} Inserts a horizontal navigation bar of the given ⟨width⟩ into a template.

macros.name: insertverticalnavigation
macros.doc: \insertverticalnavigation{⟨width⟩} Inserts a vertical navigation bar of the given ⟨width⟩ into a template.
